Immigration wait times · October 2026 · updated 2 October 2026

How Long Is the Immigration Queue at Da Nang Airport in October 2026?

In October 2026, the last passengers off a flight landing between 20:00 and 24:00 need an estimated 83–104 minutes from touchdown to leaving immigration at Da Nang International Airport (DAD). Flights landing 00:00–06:00 clear in 37–45 minutes. With Fast Track it is about 10 minutes, or 10–15 at the busiest hours.

When Fast Track matters most

Flights landing 10:00–16:00 and 20:00–24:00, when arrivals from Busan, Seoul, Kuala Lumpur and Singapore land minutes apart. Land 00:00–06:00 — you may not need us, and we will say so.

October 2026 notes

October is Da Nang's wettest month, and from 25 October the winter schedule starts — the late-evening Korean bank from Seoul, Busan, Daegu and Cheongju grows again. Six of those flights now land between 23:00 and midnight.

How we estimate: a minute-by-minute queue model over the 53 international arrivals on a typical October weekday, counting deplaning and the walk to the hall, and checked against the waits travellers report here. Estimates, not measurements — season by season in our Da Nang Airport wait-time guide.

What We Offer

What Is Airport Fast Track?

Da Nang International Airport (DAD) is Central Vietnam's gateway to Hoi An, Ba Na Hills and the coast — its Terminal 2 earned a Skytrax 5-Star rating in 2024 and 2025. On a quiet day you'll clear immigration in minutes. But when Korean and Chinese flights land together, queues build fast. Fast Track is a licensed airport assistance service that keeps you to 10–15 minutes, whatever the crowd.

Peak hours — DAD T2

When the Banks Land

When two or three Korean or Chinese flights touch down within the same hour, the Terminal 2 immigration hall fills quickly — 45 to 90 minutes, and longer during Tet, the summer rush or the fireworks festival. A long line before your holiday has even started.

Your name. Our sign.

We're Already Waiting

Step into Terminal 2 and our assistant is already there — holding a sign with your name. No searching for the right exit at Da Nang's international terminal, no confusion. Just follow and relax.

Priority Lane — DAD T2

Through in 10–15 Minutes

We guide you through the priority immigration lane, handle the paperwork, and escort you straight to the exit. While the regular line is still halfway through the hall, you're already on the road to Hoi An or your beach resort.

The Difference

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before booking your Fast Track at Da Nang Airport. Still have questions? Chat with us on WhatsApp.

You must already have a valid entry document — one of the following:

  • E-Visa (applied online in advance)
  • Visa on Arrival approval letter
  • Visa Exemption — Korea, Japan & EU 45 days; ASEAN 30 days
  • Temporary Residence Card
  • APEC Business Travel Card

Note: Fast Track is for foreign passport holders only. Vietnamese passport holders use the autogate system.

In October 2026, the last passengers off a flight landing between 20:00 and 24:00 need an estimated 83–104 minutes from touchdown to leaving immigration. Flights landing 00:00–06:00 clear in 37–45 minutes.

With Fast Track it is about 10 minutes, and 10–15 even at the busiest hours. See the estimate for your landing time (updated 2 October 2026).

Fast Track Arrival ([daf_price service="fast_track_arrival"]/person) — our assistant meets you at Terminal 2 on landing, guides you through the priority immigration lane and handles the paperwork. You clear immigration in 10–15 minutes. Baggage Assistance (+$15/person) and VIP Lane (+$20/person) are available as optional add-ons.

Fast Track Departure ([daf_price service="fast_track_departure"]/person) — we meet you at the Terminal 2 departure entrance and guide you through the priority exit immigration lane, so you skip the passport-control queue. Priority Security Screening (+$15/person) or Priority Security + Check-in (+$35/person) can be added.

No. Our service fee covers personal assistance only. Official government fees (such as Visa on Arrival stamping fees) are paid separately and directly to the authorities on the day of service. We'll always tell you any applicable fees in advance. Note there's no ATM inside the immigration area, so bring USD or VND for any visa fee.

Yes, a $10 surcharge per person applies for night flights. The windows differ slightly between services:

  • Arrivals: between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM
  • Departures: between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM

Many Korean and Chinese flights at Da Nang fall in these hours. Our service is available 24/7 regardless of flight time.

Add-ons are priced per person. On arrival:

  • Baggage Assistance (+$15) — your agent helps collect and carry your luggage
  • VIP Lane (+$20) — a dedicated lane with zero queue

On departure (choose one):

  • Priority Security Screening (+$15) — dedicated priority security lane
  • Priority Security + Check-in (+$35) — priority security lane plus priority check-in counter

Just let us know when booking and we'll add them to your confirmation.

For arrivals, our assistant waits inside the Terminal 2 international arrival area, holding a sign with your name — right before the immigration control, and then guides you through the priority lane.

For departures, we meet you at the Terminal 2 departure entrance. We send the exact meeting point after confirmation.

No problem at all. We monitor your flight in real time and adjust accordingly. Our assistant will be there whether your flight lands early, on time, or late.

Yes — the service works for solo travelers, couples, families and larger groups. Just tell us the number of passengers when booking. For children:

  • Infants under 2 travel free of charge
  • Passengers aged 2 and over pay the full price

Families with young children especially benefit — no standing in a long queue with kids after a long flight. Add Baggage Assistance if you're travelling heavy.

We confirm your booking first — no advance payment required. Payment is made online via PayPal or credit card (no PayPal account needed). We send a secure payment link after confirmation. We don't accept cash payment.

Book directly through the website checkout, or via WhatsApp or email — just send your flight number, date, number of passengers and chosen service. We confirm within 10 minutes, day or night.

Many guests book both arrival and departure for complete peace of mind — start and end your Da Nang trip hassle-free. Just share both flight details when booking.
